title: Floats
new: `animation-composition:add` accumulates translate. A replace-mode x is mid-add.
not: Not r164 offset-path distance, not r160 @property angle.
teach: Add composition is not replace. Remeasure after both animations run.

title: Buoys
new: `offset-rotate:auto` turns the hit diamond to the path tangent. Stored axis-aligned x misses.
not: Not r164 offset-path/distance, not r160 @property sweep.
teach: Auto rotate changes the used box. Click the buoy ref.

title: Type
new: `font-variation-settings: "wdth" 75` condenses so the label wraps over File.
not: Not r177 font-size-adjust, not r182 text-autospace wrap.
teach: Width axis reflow is not a new control. File the ref, not the wrapped glyph.

title: Labels
new: `line-clamp:2` + block-ellipsis so the visible BIND… is not the accessible name.
not: Not r189 hyphenate-limit-chars, not r159 pretty wrap.
teach: Ellipsis is not the name. File the a11y string.

title: Lists
new: `@counter-style` symbols() paints IV for 4. OCR IV is not item 6 and not a value.
not: Not r38 gridcell recycle, not r161 reading-order.
teach: A counter glyph is not the item id. Keep the listitem ref.

title: Chips
new: `caret-shape:block` paints over the next chip. The caret is not CH-4.
not: Not r163 :focus-visible outline, not r190 ::highlight.
teach: A block caret is a paint overlay. Keep the focused chip ref.

title: Blends
new: `mix-blend-mode:plus-lighter` blows the selected chip to white so a screenshot looks empty.
not: Not r178 multiply, not r168 light-dark.
teach: plus-lighter is not unselected. Keep aria-selected / the ref.

title: Labels
new: `background-clip:text` leaves the padding box unpainted. Center click is empty.
not: Not r174 shape-outside hole, not r129 clip-path.
teach: Unpainted padding is still the element's hit if you use the ref. Center x is a hole.

title: Marks
new: `object-fit:none` + `object-position:20% 50%` paints pixels that are not the border-box center.
not: Not r158 object-view-box inset, not r185 image-set dpr.
teach: Unscaled pixels can sit in a corner. The mark ref is the border box.

title: Plats
new: `image-rendering:pixelated` makes a screenshot blob an island of device pixels, not the CSS center.
not: Not r185 image-set 2x, not r109 CSS zoom.
teach: Nearest-neighbor islands are not hit targets. Use the plat ref.

title: Rays
new: `offset-path: ray(45deg)` is not `path()`. The used point slides along the ray.
not: Not r164 offset-path/distance on a path, not r160 angle animation.
teach: A ray restacks vs a stored path x. Keep the item ref.

title: Entries
new: `animation-range: entry` runs the timeline only while entering. Mid-entry x is not settled.
not: Not r146 view-transition-types, not r135 scroll-timeline.
teach: Entry range is not the full scroller. Wait for 100% or use the ref.

title: Floats
new: `position-visibility: anchors-visible` hides the fallback when the anchor leaves. Stale xy is empty.
not: Not r125 position-try flip, not r167 anchor-size.
teach: Hidden fallback is not File. Re-find the invoker or stop.

new: `command=show-picker` invoker opens the date picker. Clicking Open is not choosing a day.

teach: An invoker is not a value. Save the input after a day is selected.

title: Memos

not: Not r183 white-space-collapse, not r206 plaintext-only.
teach: Hard wrap mutates the value. File without inserted breaks, or declare wrap.

title: Equations
new: `math-shift:compact` shrinks a MathML fraction so the used box covers File.
not: Not r179 initial-letter, not r188 ruby-overhang.
teach: Compact math is a used box. File is still the button ref.

title: Labels

not: Not r141 text-wrap:balance overlay, not r176 margin-trim.
teach: Cloned decoration is still LB-4. Do not keep the neighbor under the extra pad.

title: Labels

not: Not r189 hyphenate-limit-chars, not r215 line-clamp.
teach: A last-line hyphen is not the accessible name.

title: Type
new: `font-optical-sizing:auto` after a size bump changes glyph width so stored x is TY-4.
not: Not r177 font-size-adjust, not r214 wdth axis.

title: Cards

title: Labels
new: `text-decoration-skip-ink:none` strikes through bowls so OCR reads B1NDING.
not: Not r189 hyphenate OCR, not r256 text-shadow ghost.

new: `dirname` posts name.dir=rtl. Saving the visual string without the dir field 422s.

teach: dirname is part of the payload. Visual text is not the whole form.

title: Cards
new: `timeline-scope: --view` lifts a named view timeline so a child animation binds a different scroller.
not: Not r135 scroll-timeline, not r211 view-timeline-inset.
teach: Scope rebinds the named timeline. A progress x from the old scroller is stale.

title: Cards
new: `view-timeline-axis:inline` drives progress from x, not y. A block-axis 50% is a different card.
not: Not r135 scroll-timeline, not r211 view-timeline-inset.
teach: Axis is which dimension. Remeasure on the live axis.

title: Previews
new: `position-try-order:most-width` picks a different fallback than first-fit. Stored flip x is empty.
not: Not r125 position-try flip, not r224 position-visibility.
teach: most-width is not first fallback. Remeasure the winning try.

title: Previews
new: `position-area: span-left` (not inset-area) slides the popover over File.
not: Not r125 position-try, not r167 anchor-size.
teach: position-area is a grid vs the anchor. Span-left can cover File. Use the ref.

title: Lines
new: `stroke-dashoffset:24` moves the painted dash so the old x is a gap, not LN-3.
not: Not r164 offset-path, not r129 clip-path.
teach: A dash gap is not a miss on the path ref. Click the path, not the empty dash.

title: Glyphs
new: `dominant-baseline:hanging` moves the SVG glyph up so stored y is GL-6.
not: Not r162 text-box-trim, not r179 initial-letter.
teach: Hanging baseline is live metrics. Click the glyph ref.

title: Memos
new: `white-space-trim:trim-all` drops leading/trailing spaces from the used value. Visual pad is not the payload.
not: Not r183 white-space-collapse, not r192 text-spacing-trim.
teach: trim-all changes the value, not just wrap. File the trimmed string or declare spaces.

title: Glyphs
new: `paint-order:stroke fill` puts a fat stroke on top of the next chip so a screenshot click hits stroke.
not: Not r188 ruby-overhang, not r163 focus-visible.
teach: Stroke-on-top is paint. Keep the glyph ref, not the halo.

title: Lines
new: `vector-effect:non-scaling-stroke` keeps stroke 1px after zoom so a screenshot fat-stroke x misses.
not: Not r109 CSS zoom, not r185 image-set.
teach: Non-scaling stroke is not a wider hit. Click the path ref.

title: Shapes
new: CSS `d` property restretches an SVG path. Stored end-x is a different shape.
not: Not r164 offset-path, not r199 shape().
teach: d is live geometry. Remeasure or use the path ref.

title: Swatches
new: `fill-opacity:0` on the selected swatch looks empty. aria-selected is still SW-2.
not: Not r218 plus-lighter, not r178 multiply.
teach: Zero fill is not unselected. Keep the selected ref.

title: Rows
new: `place-content:center` now works on block boxes, shifting every child y.
not: Not r166 align-tracks, not r176 margin-trim.
teach: Block alignment is live. Stored start y is a different row.

title: Rows
new: `baseline-source:first` aligns the grid to the first line so a last-line y is RW-2.
not: Not r162 text-box-trim, not r273 dominant-baseline.
teach: Which baseline is used is live. Click the row ref.

title: Labels
new: `hyphenate-character:"•"` so OCR reads BIND• not BINDING. Not r189 limit-chars.
not: Not r189 hyphenate-limit-chars, not r229 limit-last.
teach: The hyphen glyph is not the name. File the a11y string.

title: Cols
new: `tab-size:2` collapses tab stops so a tab-8 x is a different column.
not: Not r186 typed attr gap, not r172 sibling-count.
teach: tab-size is live metrics. Remeasure after the change.

title: Quotes

not: Not r187 hanging-punctuation:first, not r188 ruby-overhang.
teach: A last hanging quote is the previous chip's paint in the next chip's pad.

title: Rubies
new: `ruby-align:space-around` spreads rt into the previous chip. Not r188 overhang or r233 position.
not: Not r188 ruby-overhang, not r233 ruby-position:under.
teach: space-around rt can cover a neighbor. Hit Gloss, not rt.

title: Glyphs
new: `text-emphasis-position:under` drops sesame marks onto the next chip (r195 was style, not position).
not: Not r195 text-emphasis sesame style, not r233 ruby-position.
teach: Emphasis position can cover the next control. Hit the glyph ref.

title: Tokens
new: `overflow-wrap:anywhere` splits TOKEN without a break opportunity. OCR TOK is not the value.
not: Not r235 line-break:anywhere, not r215 line-clamp.
teach: anywhere wrap is not the token. File the a11y string.

title: Labels
new: `hyphens:manual` only breaks at ­. OCR BIND- is not BINDING.
not: Not r189 hyphenate-limit-chars, not r229 limit-last.
teach: A soft hyphen is not the accessible name.

title: Type
new: `font-synthesis-weight:none` leaves faux-bold as regular so OCR/contrast reads a different control.
not: Not r237 font-synthesis-small-caps, not r177 font-size-adjust.
teach: Missing weight synthesis is not a new verb. File the button ref.

title: Type
new: `font-synthesis-style:none` leaves faux-italic as roman so OCR reads a different control.
not: Not r288 synth-weight, not r237 synth-small-caps.
teach: Missing italic synthesis is not a new verb. File the button ref.

title: Badges
new: `color-scheme: only dark` forbids light UA chrome. A light screenshot blob is not the badge.
not: Not r168 light-dark(), not r207 forced-colors.
teach: only dark remaps UA widgets. Keep the a11y ref.

title: Floats
new: `@media (update: slow)` pauses the motion so a mid-flight x is frozen on FL-4.
not: Not r212 composition-add, not r223 animation-range.
teach: Slow update freezes animation. Do not keep a mid-flight x.

title: Toasts
new: `@media (prefers-reduced-transparency: reduce)` makes a frost veil opaque so clicks never reach Ack.
not: Not r250 backdrop-filter, not r111 pe:none.
teach: An opaque reduced-transparency veil is a hit. Ack is still the button ref.

title: Checks
new: `@media (prefers-contrast: more)` adds a 4px outline so the neighbor looks selected.
not: Not r163 :focus-visible, not r256 accent-color.
teach: A contrast outline is not checked state. Commit the input ref.

title: Cards
new: `scroll-padding-inline:64px` stops scrollIntoView early (r246 was scroll-margin on the item).
not: Not r246 scroll-margin-inline, not r147 scroll-start-target.
teach: Padding is on the scroller. The snapped paint is a different card.

title: Lanes
new: `overscroll-behavior-x:none` traps a horizontal fling. The parent scroller does not advance.
not: Not r143 overscroll-behavior contain (block), not r245 snap-stop.
teach: x none is not y contain. Keep the inner snapped item, not the parent.

title: Rows
new: `scrollbar-width:none` removes the gutter so stored x in the old gutter is empty (not r142 scrollbar-gutter).
not: Not r142 scrollbar-gutter stable vs overlay, not r52 custom scrollbar.
teach: No scrollbar is not overlay. The old gutter x is a hole.

title: Rows
new: `scrollbar-color: CanvasText Canvas` makes the thumb look like a row. A screenshot click is the thumb.
not: Not r142 scrollbar-gutter, not r296 scrollbar-width.
teach: A themed thumb is not a row. Keep the row ref.

title: Chips
new: `caret-color:transparent` hides the caret so a screenshot looks unfocused on CH-3.
not: Not r217 caret-shape, not r255 caret-animation.
teach: A missing caret is not unfocused. Keep the focused chip ref.

title: Checks
new: `appearance:base` (not base-select) strips the check glyph so a checked box looks empty.
not: Not r133 appearance:base-select, not r256 accent-color Canvas.
teach: Base appearance is not unchecked. Commit aria-checked.

title: Lists
new: `::marker` is a generated hit. Clicking the marker is not the listitem.
not: Not r197 ::scroll-marker, not r216 @counter-style.
teach: A marker is not the item. Keep the listitem ref.

title: Queries
new: `::placeholder` paints Search… . That string is not the input value.
not: Not r39 searchbox typeahead, not r264 search element.
teach: A placeholder is not a query. Find empty or the typed value.

title: Notes
new: `::selection` with pointer-events on a custom highlight eats the next chip (not r190 ::highlight API).
not: Not r190 ::highlight(search), not r231 user-select:contain.
teach: A selection overlay is still NT-5. Keep the article ref.

title: Texts
new: `orphans:4` pulls the last paragraph to the next fragment so stored y is TX-7.
not: Not r267 column-height, not r228 box-decoration-break.
teach: Orphans move whole paragraphs. Remeasure after the fragment.

title: Cards
new: `break-inside:avoid` shoves the whole card into the next column. Stored col-1 x is empty.

title: Heads
new: `column-span:all` makes the heading a full-width band so stored col-1 y is a card.
not: Not r267 column-height, not r304 break-inside.
teach: span-all is a new used box. Click the heading ref.

title: Texts
new: `column-rule-width:16px` is a painted gutter. A center click between columns is the rule, not a card.
not: Not r142 scrollbar-gutter, not r267 column-height.
teach: A column rule is not a card. Click the article ref.

title: Chips
new: `flex-basis:content` sizes from max-content so stored 0-basis x is CH-4.
not: Not r137 field-sizing, not r149 calc-size.
teach: content basis is live metrics. Remeasure or use the chip ref.

title: Rows
new: `align-content:safe center` refuses to overflow start so a tall stack pins to start, not visual center.
not: Not r279 place-content block, not r166 align-tracks.
teach: safe vs unsafe changes y. Stored unsafe-center y is a different row.

title: Cards
new: `justify-self:end` slides one grid item so stored start x is empty.
not: Not r171 if() restack, not r165 masonry.

not: Not r164 offset-path, not r213 offset-rotate, not competing mill offset-anchor.

title: Shapes
new: `transform-box:fill-box` rotates about the SVG fill box, not the CSS border box.
not: Not r276 vector-effect, not r277 d property.
teach: fill-box origin is not border-box. Click the path ref.

title: Cards
new: Individual `scale: 1.25` (not transform) grows the used box so stored unscaled x is CD-3.
not: Not r109 CSS zoom, not r185 image-set.
teach: The scale property is live metrics. Remeasure or use the ref.

title: Cards
new: Individual `translate: 24px 0` (not transform) moves the used box.
not: Not r312 scale property, not r164 offset-path.
teach: The translate property is live metrics. Remeasure or use the ref.

title: Cards
new: Individual `rotate: 18deg` (not transform, not offset-rotate) turns the used box.
not: Not r213 offset-rotate:auto, not r312 scale.
teach: The rotate property changes the hit diamond. Click the card ref.

title: Swatches
new: `background-blend-mode:difference` cancels the selected fill so a screenshot looks empty.
not: Not r218 plus-lighter, not r178 multiply.
teach: A blended-away fill is still selected. Keep the ref.

title: Cards
new: `box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 24px` paints over the padding so center x looks like a hole.
not: Not r219 background-clip:text, not r174 shape-outside.
teach: An inset shadow is still the card. Click the ref, not the painted hole.

title: Verbs
new: `filter: drop-shadow(8px 0)` ghosts a second glyph. Not r252 text-shadow (that is text-only).
not: Not r252 text-shadow, not r249 filter:url displace.
teach: A drop-shadow is not a second control. File the a11y name.

title: Seals
new: `clip-path: xywh()` (not inset/polygon) leaves the layout center outside the clip.
not: Not r129 clip-path polygon, not r199 shape().
teach: xywh is a different function. Hit the remaining lobe ref.

title: Texts
new: `shape-margin:24px` grows the exclusion so stored wrap x is a different line (r174 was the shape itself).
not: Not r174 shape-outside polygon, not r199 shape().
teach: shape-margin is extra exclusion. Remeasure the wrap.

title: Marks
new: `object-position:0% 50%` with cover (not object-fit:none r220) slides painted pixels.
not: Not r220 object-fit:none, not r158 object-view-box.
